titulo: Unit 1: Present Tenses & Hardware Basics (RA1, RA2)

paginas.contenido:
Welcome to Unit 1. This unit focuses on foundational IT skills and the grammar needed to describe current states and ongoing tasks.
  • RA1 & RA2: Recognizing hardware components and understanding technical documentation.
  • Grammar Goals: Mastering the Present Simple and Present Continuous to talk about habits and current projects.
  • Vocabulary: Essential hardware parts and actions like troubleshooting and assembling.

💡 Nota: Esta unidad es el punto de partida para describir qué hace un sistema y en qué estás trabajando ahora mismo.

Every ASIR technician must identify the internal parts of a computer system.
ComponentDescription
MotherboardThe main printed circuit board (PCB) that connects all components.
CPU (Processor)The 'brain' of the computer that executes instructions.
RAMVolatile memory used for temporary data storage while the PC is on.
Hard Drive (HDD/SSD)Non-volatile storage for permanent data.
Power Supply (PSU)Converts electricity from the outlet to the components.

💡 Nota: El disco duro almacena datos de forma permanente, a diferencia de la RAM.

paginas.titulo: IT Actions: Verbs you need to know
paginas.contenido:
In your daily work, you will perform these key actions.
  • Troubleshoot: To identify, locate, and fix problems in hardware or software.
  • Assemble: To put together all the parts of a computer system.
  • Upgrade: To improve a system by adding or replacing components (e.g., adding more RAM).
  • Configure: To set up software or hardware to work in a specific way.

Used for facts, permanent situations, and regular habits.

Structure:

Subject + Verb (adds -s for he/she/it)

Examples:

  • "The server runs 24/7."
  • "My parents live in London."
  • "She does not work on Sundays."

💡 Nota: Usamos el Present Simple para cosas que son siempre verdad o rutinas.

Used for actions happening now or around the present time (temporary).

Structure:

Subject + Am/Is/Are + Verb-ing

Examples:

  • "I am troubleshooting the network right now."
  • "They are working on a new project this week."
  • "The team is upgrading the servers this month."

💡 Nota: Palabras como 'now', 'at the moment' o 'this week' suelen indicar Present Continuous.

Knowing the difference helps you use 'much/many' and 'a/an' correctly.
  • Countable: Things you can count. Have plural forms. (Computer/Computers, Person/People).
  • Uncountable: Concepts or substances. No plural form. (Information, Water, Furniture, Hardware, Software).

💡 Nota: En inglés, 'Information' y 'Software' NUNCA llevan 's'. No digas 'softwares'.

Review these core concepts for Unit 1.
  • Hardware: CPU (brain), Motherboard (hub), RAM (temporary), HDD (permanent).
  • Present Simple: For facts and routines ("He works every day").
  • Present Continuous: For temporary actions ("He is working today").
  • Countables: 'People' is countable. 'Information' is NOT.
Complete this test to confirm you have mastered the Unit 1 content.

preguntas_test.q: Which component stores information permanently on a computer?
preguntas_test.explicacion: El disco duro (Hard drive) es almacenamiento no volátil, guarda los datos incluso sin corriente.
preguntas_test.ejemplo: Ej: 'I saved the files on the Hard drive.'

preguntas_test.explicacion: Usamos Present Simple para situaciones permanentes. Con 'parents' (ellos), el verbo no lleva -s.

preguntas_test.q: What is the main responsibility of someone who 'troubleshoots' computers?
preguntas_test.explicacion: 'Troubleshoot' significa identificar y resolver fallos técnicos.

preguntas_test.q: They __________ (work) on the project this week.

preguntas_test.explicacion: 'People' es el plural de 'person' y se puede contar. Las otras son incontables.
preguntas_test.ejemplo: Ej: 'There are many people in the office.'

preguntas_test.q: What does it mean to 'assemble' a computer?
preguntas_test.explicacion: 'Assemble' es el proceso de montar el hardware físicamente.
preguntas_test.ejemplo: Ej: 'It takes an hour to assemble a PC.'

preguntas_test.explicacion: Negativo en Present Simple para 3ª persona: 'does not' + forma base.

preguntas_test.q: Which part is known as the 'brain' of the computer?
preguntas_test.explicacion: La CPU (Central Processing Unit) procesa todas las instrucciones.
preguntas_test.ejemplo: Ej: 'The CPU speed is measured in GHz.'

preguntas_test.explicacion: 'Upgrading' suele implicar mejorar el hardware físico.

preguntas_test.q: The team __________ (work) on a new project this month.
preguntas_test.explicacion: Acción temporal referida al equipo como entidad: Present Continuous.
